gitHubOrg.description: GitHub organization or user that owns the repos

repos.description: Repositories to onboard. Each entry is either a plain name (empty repo, no template) or an object selecting a starter template.

oneOf.description: Repository name (empty repo). Derives rg-<name> and sp-<name>-github.

template.description: Starter template the repo is scaffolded from (GitHub template repository)

auth.description: Grant the repo's deploy SP the Graph app roles for declarative Entra Easy Auth (Application.ReadWrite.OwnedBy + User.Read.All), so its own Bicep can create the auth app. container-app repos also scaffold Easy Auth in their template. Default: true for container-app, false for other templates — a template-none repo that builds its own infra (e.g. trading-lab) opts in explicitly.

preview.description: Create a per-branch preview environment: an isolated rg-<name>-preview + sp-<name>-preview-github (Owner of that RG only, federated to any branch) so non-main branches can deploy to a sandbox, never to prod. Default false.

onboarding.description: azure-only entries are skipped by automatic onboarding and explicitly dispatched through onboard-azure-only.yml. Only template none without preview is supported. The app repo owns its config and guides; no GitHub Secrets/Variables are written.

manageApplications.description: Azure-only: grant Application.ReadWrite.OwnedBy to the deploy SP for owned application/SP definitions. Does not grant User.Read.All unless auth is also true. Requires concrete access approval before dispatch.

oidcPullRequests.description: Azure-only: trust pull_request in addition to main. Defaults false for azure-only, true for existing automatic entries. False refuses existing non-main credentials; it does not delete them.

sharedAcr.description: Shared-registry access for this repo, applied by scripts/derive-acr-grants.ps1 (via apply-role-grants.ps1). Omit to use the default: enabled for template 'container-app', disabled otherwise. Set false to never derive grants; true to enable with defaults; or an object to override them.

oneOf.description: true = enable with defaults; false = derive no shared-ACR grants for this repo.

pullIdentities.description: Runtime managed identities that pull images, each granted ABAC-conditioned 'Container Registry Repository Reader' on this repo's '<name>/' path (and '<name>-preview/' when preview is true). Default ["id-<name>"]. Override when the app's identity is not named after the repo — the container-app template derives it from appName, so article-to-speech uses id-articletts — or when a repo has several (trading-lab, agent).

cloudBuild.description: Whether this repo's CI SP also gets the two UNCONDITIONED control-plane roles that 'az acr build' and 'az acr import' require (Container Registry Tasks Contributor, Container Registry Data Importer and Data Reader). Neither can carry an ABAC condition. Set false for a repo that builds with docker and only pushes via 'az acr login', so it is not granted registry-wide capabilities it never uses.
